changelog: Studio opens maximized by default across Windows and Linux with preserved restore bounds
Direct database (.sql/.ddl) file importer with file dialog and drag-and-drop loading
Instant schema analysis badge displaying loaded file name, size, line count, and table count

Single-instance named pipe parameter forwarding with zero secondary popups
Automatic window focus and restoration (Win32 ShowWindow / SetForegroundWindow)
RFC 3986 scheme compliance and reserved protocol blacklist security hardening
